Proof in the paper: The peaks belonging to NiSe (PDF No.18–0887) were characterized by XRD (Fig. S1). The interplanar distances of 2.85 and 3.01 Å can be identified as (300) and (101) planes of NiSe, respectively, as shown in the High-resolution TEM (HRTEM) image (Fig. 1f). The selected-area electron-diffraction (SAED) pattern displays discrete spots corresponding to the (300), (021) planes of the NiSe (Fig. 1g).
